items.title: Dave Brubeck — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Danny was on cymbals. He was ten years old. So even hanging out at rehearsals, here’s a record session where the kids did something constructive.

ctx.x: Do you think Earle would mind being . . . Earle Weatherwax is his name. He went on to be an entertainer in nightclubs as singer and pianist. We see him quite frequently. Chris see him, and Danny sees him a lot.
Where does he live? Do you know, Russell?
